value.label: source-and-qa
value.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
raw=Path('benchmarks/local/eggcc-encoding-case-study').resolve()
e=json.loads((raw/'encoding-study/checkpoint.json').read_text()); count=0
for row in e['files']:
 assert hashlib.sha256((Path(e['worktree'])/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(row['archive']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']; count+=1
assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--binary'],cwd=e['worktree'])).hexdigest()==e['patch_sha256']
c=json.loads((raw/'retarget/prototype/final/checkpoint.json').read_text())
for relative,expected in c['source_files_sha256'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((Path(c['worktree'])/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
 assert hashlib.sha256((raw/'retarget/prototype/final/source'/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected; count+=1
for name in ['engine-control','feature-control','reproduction']:
 q=json.loads((raw/name/'figure-qa/receipt.json').read_text()); assert q['status'] in ['passed','success'],(name,q['status'])
for name,expected in [('engine-control',48),('feature-control',144),('reproduction',48)]:
 j=json.loads((raw/name/'results.json').read_text()); assert j['status']=='complete' and len(j['rows'])==expected
assert (raw/'reproduction/transformations/receipt.json').is_file()
print(json.dumps({'status':'success','unchanged_source_files':count,'figure_qa_receipts':3,'complete_datasets':3,'fresh_transformation_receipt':True}))
PY
